units.source_text: 正殿东面，本来是明石女御所居，此时女御带着新生的小皇子回宫去了，这院子里很空。

en.t: East of the main hall had originally been the residence of the Akashi Consort, but now she had returned to the palace with the newborn young prince, leaving the courtyard very empty.

units.source_text: 夕雾等便在离开湖边稍远的地方找定了一处良好的蹴鞠场。

en.t: Yugiri and the others therefore chose a fine place for kemari a little way back from the lakeside.

units.source_text: 太政大臣家诸公子，如头弁、兵卫佐、大夫等，有的年事已长，有的尚未成年，个个都是出人头地的蹴鞠好手。

en.t: The sons of the Grand Minister's household, such as the Head Chamberlain, the Assistant Captain of the Guards, and the Senior Secretary, some already grown and some not yet of age, were all outstanding kemari players.

units.source_text: 日色渐暮，头弁说道：“今天没有风，正是蹴鞠的好日子！”

en.t: As the light of day gradually faded, the Head Chamberlain said, "There is no wind today; it is perfect weather for kemari!"

units.source_text: 他忍耐不住，也就下去参加蹴鞠了。

en.t: Unable to hold himself back, he too went down and joined the game.
Genji saw this and said, "Look at that!

units.source_text: 连头弁官也忍耐不住，下去参加了。

en.t: Even the Head Chamberlain could not resist and has gone down to join in.

units.source_text: 这里几个身居高位的，都是青年武官，怎的不去参加呢？

en.t: The high-ranking men here are all young military officers, so why do they not go and take part?

units.source_text: 像我这样上了年纪的人，只能漠然地袖手旁观，真乃遗憾之至。

en.t: Someone as old as I am can only stand by idly and watch, which is truly a great pity.

units.source_text: 不过蹴鞠这种游戏，实在太粗暴了。”

en.t: Still, kemari is really far too rough a game."

units.source_text: 夕雾大将和柏木卫门督听了这话，都下去参加了。

en.t: Hearing these words, General Yugiri and Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, both went down and joined in.

units.source_text: 许多公子映着夕阳，在美不可言的花阴下来往奔走，这景象煞是好看！

en.t: Many young nobles, glowing in the evening sun, ran back and forth beneath the indescribably beautiful shade of the blossoms, making a wonderfully lovely sight.
